propositions: Negative caplog assertions pass vacuously when zero records are captured, providing false confidence in coverage without failing
Logger propagation disabled or level raised mid-process causes downstream caplog assertions to silently fail to capture expected records
Five negative assertions across the test suite are vulnerable to void coverage when logger state is mutated globally without restoration
A guard mechanism must detect logger propagation disabled or level raised and fail loudly at the source of mutation rather than at a random downstream victim test
Caplog coverage integrity must be deterministic across test runs regardless of execution order and worker distribution
The guard must distinguish between legitimate in-process side effects (log level containment) and defective mutations (propagation disabled without restoration)
